summary: Produced a compilable TikZ reconstruction (version 4, best version). It draws the six measured vertices A–F from CV coordinates: AB, B–E–D, A–E–C, DC, A–F–D and FE, all solid, with labels bound to their vertices. The automatic Critic review scored v4 at 0.90, with must_repair=false and topology_check passed. The E label clash with the BD and AC strokes was resolved by moving it to right with xshift=4pt.
